name: yao_open_prompts_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the yao_open_prompts capability.

prompts.name: content_creation
prompts.template: Create a detailed and engaging article on the topic: {prompt_context}. Please write in {language}.
prompts.use_case: Generating marketing copy or advertisements in English and Chinese.

prompts.name: marketing_ad_copy
prompts.template: Generate persuasive marketing ad copy for the product/service: {prompt_context} in {language}.
prompts.use_case: Creating bilingual content and learning materials for educational purposes.

prompts.name: learning_material
prompts.template: Provide an educational explanation or summary about: {prompt_context} in {language} suitable for learners.
prompts.use_case: Constructing AI prompts to assist in workplace automation or task completion.

prompts.name: daily_use_assistant
prompts.template: Assist with the following daily task or question: {prompt_context}. Use {language}.
prompts.use_case: Developing tailored AI prompts to aid in daily personal productivity.
